quest.title: Honorary Knight's Notes on Mixology
quest.description: The Knights of Favonius are about to open their drinks stand. Hertha from the Logistics Company is looking for help...

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Hello there, Honorary Knight and the Helper in White!

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: It's so nice to meet you, Honorary Knight and Lady Paimon. Glenfidia, at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you're in a good mood, Hertha! And nice to meet you, Glenfidia!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the looks of things, you're about ready to open?

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Indeed! Thanks to some help from the Angel's Share and The Cat's Tail, our drinks stand is ready to go.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Besides all the classics, we also mix cocktails to order and are currently offering a limited-time delivery service...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you remember that time we served as bartenders at the Angel's Share? And recently you've also shown off your skills at The Flagship in Nod-Krai... We sure have come a long way, huh?

choices.text: Wow, that really was a long time ago.

response.speaker: Hertha
response.text: The only thing is... Our current drink selection is quite traditional, and it stopped feeling fresh long before the expedition began. To offer everyone some more exciting choices, we're planning to revamp our menu.

response.speaker: Hertha
response.text: But I need to get back to handling resident requests, and Glenfidia doesn't have much experience mixing drinks. Plus, we've got a whole bunch of outstanding delivery orders on hand...

response.speaker: Hertha
response.text: Honorary Knight, if you're free, could you maybe... help us out for a while? Just until my other squad gets back from the Stormbearer Mountains.

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: You'll be amply compensated, of course, plus double pay for overtime — depending on your performance metrics!

choices.text: I'm no rookie when it comes to mixing cocktails, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not sure what "performance metrics" are, but she's happy to help with deliveries!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As the best guide in Teyvat, Paimon needs to keep up with the changing times. Besides, this'll give her the chance to explore the city and stay up to date with all the recent goings on!

response.speaker: Hertha
response.text: Haha, working with you two is always such a breeze!

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: I'll do my best to support Lady Paimon in any way I can. I'm very skilled when it comes to things like portioning out drinks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright — well if you're ready too, then let's get to work!

choices.text: You can leave the whole bar in my hands!
When exactly was that? I can barely remember now...
